hypothesis: Accepting finite Decimal direction states in HIP-3 readiness telemetry will make the displayed Heikin-Ashi color and order-block agreement match the predicates used for live eligibility without altering strategy semantics.
decision: Repair the shared HIP-3 numeric telemetry conversion for staged v26. A live GOLD entry proved that Decimal +1 values satisfied all four Swing/HA conditions while the same HA and order-block values were serialized as null and displayed as N/A. The regression first reproduced that contradiction and then passed after Decimal support was added. Keep the armed v25 backend and its two protected positions unchanged; verify the repair on the first completed HIP-3 Swing decision after the safe flat v26 transition.
falsifier: Falsify this repair if a v26 completed HIP-3 Swing decision with a numeric HA or order-block direction still emits null/N/A, if the displayed value disagrees with the eligibility predicate for that same decision, or if the change alters intent eligibility in a paired pre/post replay.
limitations: This revision repairs evidence visibility and does not establish signal profitability.
The running v25 process retains its loaded pre-repair code until the portfolio is flat.
The first v26 HIP-3 decision remains the required end-to-end TUI and ledger acceptance check.
No position, order, route, sizing rule, risk limit, or execution authority changed.
